title: [SmartSwitch] Enabling SmartSwitch/NPU as chrony NTP server inadvertently is also enabling DPU as chrony NTP server
author: tirupatihemanth
body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

The changes to enable the NPU (SmartSwitch) as a Chrony NTP server for its connected DPUs, allowing them to synchronize time locally within the chassis environment is also inadvertently enabling DPUs as chrony NTP servers. 

These changes were first introduced through https://github.com/sonic-net/sonic-buildimage/pull/22513
I see that on the DPU at `/etc/chrony/chrony.conf`

```
root@sonic:/etc/chrony# cat chrony.conf
....
server 169.254.200.254 iburst

allow
binddevice bridge-midplane
...
```

"allow" in the chrony configuration tells chrony to act as an NTP server and listen for requests. We see this configuration even in the dpu eventhough it's meant only for the switch as per the above PR.

This is because at `sonic-buildimage/files/image_config/chrony/chrony.conf.j2` the following conditions also match for the dpu

```
{# Enable the NTP server configuration only if the switch type is smartswitch -#}
{% if device_metadata.subtype == 'SmartSwitch' -%}
{# Enable NTP server functionality if server_role is enabled or DHCP configuration is enabled -#}
{% if global.server_role == 'enabled' or global.dhcp == 'enabled' -%}
allow
binddevice bridge-midplane
{% endif -%}
{% endif -%}
```
Here's the values in config_db on dpu which enables above conditions to be true - subtype is still `SmartSwitch` on DPU 

```
    "NTP": {
        "global": {
            "admin_state": "enabled",
            "authentication": "disabled",
            "dhcp": "enabled",
            "server_role": "disabled",
            "src_intf": "eth0",
            "vrf": "default"
        }
    },

....

    "DEVICE_METADATA": {
        "localhost": {
             ....
            "hostname": "sonic",
            "subtype": "SmartSwitch",
            "switch_type": "dpu",
            "timezone": "UTC",
            "type": "SmartSwitchDPU"
        }
    },

```

Further there is no `bridge-midplane` interface on the DPU at all, we only have `eth0-midplane` interface on the DPU but the configuration generated by the above template configures `bridge-midplane` on the dpu


### Steps to Reproduce

1. config reload -y 
2. Wait untill all containers are up 
3. Query for errors in syslog


### Relevant log output

```shell
2025 Jun 18 05:42:33.687541 sonic ERR chronyd[2468204]: Could not open NTP socket on 0.0.0.0:123
2025 Jun 18 05:42:33.687691 sonic ERR chronyd[2468204]: Could not open NTP socket on [::]:123
```
